name: TD Cash Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR on purchases for the first 12 billing cycles after account opening. After that, 18.49%, 23.49% or 28.49% variable APR based on creditworthiness. 0% introductory APR on balance transfers for the first 15 billing cycles for transfers made within the first 90 days of account opening; after that, 18.49%, 23.49% or 28.49% variable APR.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee is 3% of each transaction in U.S. dollars.

base_rate.description: Earn unlimited 1% Cash Back on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Every quarter, choose your 3% and 2% Spend Categories from Dining, Entertainment, Gas, Grocery Stores, and Travel, plus earn 1% on all other purchases. At card opening, the default categories are 3% Cash Back on Dining and 2% at Grocery Stores. Superstores and warehouse clubs only qualify for 1% regardless of merchant category code. Cash back redeemed as a statement credit.

signup_bonus.description: Maximum bonus accumulation for this promotional offer is 20,000 points which can be redeemed for $200 Cash Back rewards. Bonus reflected on your credit card statement 6 to 8 weeks after you spend $1,000 in total net purchases within the first 90 days.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Get Visa benefits like cell phone protection when you pay your monthly mobile bill with your card.

benefits.title: Visa Zero Liability
benefits.description: Enjoy Visa security on purchases, plus protection against unauthorized charges.

benefits.title: Emergency Card Replacement
benefits.description: Every TD Bank Credit Card comes with an added layer of protection such as emergency card replacement.

benefits.title: Roadside Assistance
benefits.description: Every TD Bank Credit Card comes with roadside assistance and more.

benefits.title: Digital Wallet
benefits.description: Add your TD cards to your mobile device to simplify your online, in-store and in-app purchases.

benefits.title: Contactless Payments
benefits.description: Learn more about the convenience and security of contactless payments.

notes: Verified from official product page. Customizable 3-2-1% cash back: choose two spend categories each quarter for 3% and 2%, plus 1% on all other purchases. Default at opening is 3% Dining and 2% Grocery Stores. No annual fee. 0% intro APR on purchases for 12 billing cycles and on balance transfers for 15 billing cycles. Foreign transaction fee 3%.
